scope_note: All twelve baseline reference screens were reviewed. Newly requested selection and cache-management states belong to the next expanded review and are not represented as checked here.

new_findings.title: Tab backgrounds break the full-width divider into short segments
new_findings.observed: The white background of each unpressed Tab covers the parent divider, leaving disconnected gray line fragments.
new_findings.recommendation: Keep unpressed Tab backgrounds transparent and retain whole-control inversion only while pressed, allowing the continuous parent rule and selected underline to remain visible.

resolved_known_findings.result: Context cover art and printed titles match their respective reference editions without duplicated embedded badges.
The chapter-update count is six and is distinct from the seven-book library summary.

The summary shows eight unique visited chapters while five rows are visible. Static source inspection confirms the full persisted history is filtered to the seven-day interval before deduplication; no independent runtime formula test was executed by this reviewer.
Paperwhite printed-title variants and the wider search art preserve complete inner titles and appropriate unread-badge clearance.

known_visual_findings.observed: The history Incognito action still uses a lock rather than a crossed-eye symbol; its full label and separate trash control are present.
Sleep and storage symbols are corrected, while refresh and tap-region rows still use list and split-layout symbols instead of page and crosshair symbols.

functional_and_platform_blockers.description: The frozen remote E2E report has 56 passed cases and one failed reader-long-press case. Its state sidecar keeps modal empty, so this round cannot establish the requested page-action behavior.
Root reported a native SQLite startup/persistence issue being investigated separately. The reviewer did not independently execute the native application.

source_grid_badge_check.description: The in-library tags use the reference lower-left overlay position. The reference itself overlaps part of the title printed on the cover; the external title caption stays complete. This is not recorded as a new missing-title defect.

explicit_platform_differences.description: The orientation control should say Locked Direction when only manual rotation is implemented. Keeping that truthful label instead of the mock's Auto Rotate is an intentional capability difference, not a request to simulate an unsupported sensor path.

accepted_source_variations: The 86-chapter book keeps its true fifteen-page Paperwhite directory.
Dynamic chapter totals, seven-day counts, and installed/searchable-source counts follow actual persisted fixture state.
Device-specific speech-balloon variations in the mock art do not justify substituting different comic content for the same page.
expanded_scope_pending_round_4: Detail chapter long-press selection and batch actions
Download management with real queue state
Complete baseline regression after the shared Tab fix
Reader long-press and native-package repair evidence

reported_performance_context.limitation: This is a fixed host fixture measurement, not a claim about general throughput or Kindle hardware speed.

verification_note: This reviewer only read static screenshots, metadata, source text, and existing reports. No local application, build, test suite, or runtime probe was executed. Clean-round counting remains zero until unresolved findings and required functional fixes are resolved and a complete fresh review has no new advice.
classification_correction: The initial report classified the SQLite issue too broadly as a packaging dependency. The later sqlite-native/analysis.md establishes that the reported scope is intermittent native persistence; no corruption cause is asserted here.
